data.content_ref: inline:Add a warrant-priority layer instead of any graph enrichment: rank each attack edge by the proof-depth (length of the shortest undefeated defense chain) of its source's warrant, and compute the grounded labeling by iterating defeat resolution in ascending (priority, node-id) order, freezing each decision once made. Determinism is preserved because the iteration order is canonical; cost stays polynomial because defense chains are computed once and cached. The criticizable claim is that this breaks the neighbourhood's covering principle (SRC_007): the priority ordering is a property of the iteration, not of a monotone edge-construction pass, so it is not expressible as an admissible enrichment at the edge layer and its fixed point may differ from any edge-enriched grounded extension.
